title: Drum breaks in the old bands
summary: Williams says drum breaks were rare in the bands he played with, such as Perez and Ridgely.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, what did you call it in the old days, when the drummer would take, say, two bars or four bars, and then the band would come back for four bars?
No, just a break, you know.

Yeah, just a drum break. Very few of them done it. Many of them, you know, many of them didn't do it. Because, you know, my bands I played with, they didn't do it. Manuel Perez, Ridgely, no, they didn't do that, no.
I hear some of the white guys call that a turn around. Yeah, I see they do that, yeah.
I guess that's what they call it. I didn't even know I never played it, so I didn't even know what they called it.
